test_title: PYST 24: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

If the anesthesia is not ______ properly, he might wake up in the ______ of the surgery.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4' **i.e. **'Administered/middle'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The appropriate terms in the context of medical procedures involving anesthesia are **'administered' and 'middle'.**
 
• **When referring **to **anesthetics**, we usually use the term** 'administered' **which means given generally in a therapeutic context.
 
• The **correct sentence** should be:* "If the anesthesia is not administered properly, he might wake up in the middle of the surgery.*"

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Administered/middle'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Option 1', **'perpetuated/start' is not suitable. 'Perpetuated' means 'make continue indefinitely', and 'start' doesn't fit well with the context of a ongoing surgery.
 
• **'Option 2', **'administer/during' is partially correct. 'Administer' is apt but 'during' is not as specific as 'middle'.
 
• **'Option 3', **'perpetuated/middle' is improper use because 'perpetuated' doesn't fit the context of anesthesia given in surgery.
